detail.longDescription: Notion agents now run one task for 24+ hours, up from 5 minutes. In "Review for me" mode, a separate model checks actions before they run. Model reviewers leak: arXiv 2609.19587 got arbitrary bash past Claude Code's Auto Mode and Codex's Guardian in 79% of trials, before fixes. https://www. notion.com/blog/notion-ai-more -for-less For long agent runs in your own terminal, we built a link a person can check from a phone: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # AI # Cybersecurity
